title: Ticket: keep the last events

ticket.subject: Last events on the board
ticket.body: Show the last n events, oldest first. If there are fewer than n events, show them all. A count of 0 shows nothing.

rules: Return the last n events, oldest first.
If there are fewer than n events, return all of them.
When n is 0, return an empty list.

title: Ticket: the heaviest weights

ticket.subject: Heaviest parcels first
ticket.body: Return the n heaviest weights, heaviest first. A weight that appears twice counts twice.

rules: A weight listed twice counts twice.

title: Ticket: each dock once, in order

ticket.subject: Docks in order of arrival
ticket.body: Return each dock name once, in the order it first appears in the log. An empty log gives an empty list.

rules: The order is the order each name first appears.
An empty log gives an empty list, not None.
